scope: Original bounded successor game simulation and portable browser/C99 SDL2 project emission, under the existing Jeeves game runtime and native build owners

fidelity.input: optional fidelity.profile: pixel, enhanced or cinematic; absent defaults to pixel
fidelity.consumers: Actual browser Canvas, native SDL2 and Python preview renderer; original atlas remains bounded 2D pixel art

profiles.pixel: nearest sprites, exact authored palette, basic day/weather visualization
profiles.enhanced: graded sprite palette, stronger dynamic lighting/shadows and bounded decorative parallax/particles
profiles.cinematic: filtered sprites, warmer grading, layered haze/vignette and bounded richer ambient/event particles plus render camera interpolation

fidelity.claims: Profiles alter actual render output, not underlying hardware compatibility, licensed source fidelity or AAA/photorealistic graphics

interfaces.generation: emit_successor_project(spec) returns exact original authored spec plus portable source/assets
interfaces.build: existing ConsoleBuildRunner fixed trusted compiler and sandbox; emitted C99 SDL2 source never establishes successful compilation without actual output receipt

mechanics: fixed 60 Hz topdown movement and sideview acceleration/friction/gravity/coyote/buffer controls
original projectile/melee combat, patrol/chase/shooting enemies and boss phases
actual cast/wait/bite/reel/tension fish catch states and species
soil preparation, seed inventory, watering, growth, harvest, deterministic day/weather/season cycles
NPC dialogue, seed economy/crafting, quests, doors, relics and checkpoints
deterministic large-world camera and actual original raster frames
interactive menus, keyboard/controller bindings, synthesized local audio and save/load
state: Local pure simulation state; existing application workspace remains tenant/source/rights/durable publication authority. Native/browser saves are local player state bound to exact authored spec.
integrity: Exact canonical spec and implementation identity bind measured environment; restore validates bounded complete state before atomic adoption; source lineage is descriptive provenance, never imported code/assets or authority.
failure: Invalid/foreign geometry or state, exhausted entities, unavailable toolchain or denied sandbox fail explicitly. No hardware binary/emulation claims from portable source output.
limitations: The full browser/C99 exporter currently accepts topdown successor recipes. Sideview physics are a real Python simulation adapter, but full sideview portable export is unavailable. Fidelity profiles remain original bounded 2D pixel art, not photorealistic or AAA graphics.

learning_observation_extension.scope: Expand bounded actual top-down observations to at most32 features for target directions, facing/tool target, soil/crop/water, seed/inventory/economy prerequisites and real fishing tension/phase. Physical actions, clock, rewards and source custody remain unchanged.
learning_observation_extension.compatibility: Existing exact world implementation hash changes and fences old snapshots; no numerical migration or historical-evidence rewrite.
learning_observation_extension.authority: Existing finite local actor and application worker/source/credit fences remain authoritative.
